violations.text: Raw animal foods (beef, personal use) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (pastry) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice machine was taken out of service to be cleaned and sanitized. Ice to be disposed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2026

The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the 3-bay sink at the bar. Inspector provided. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 03/17/2026
The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine. Inspector provided. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 03/17/2026
The door to the staff toilet/mop sink room is not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 03/31/2026
